verdict.rationale: IVS's own Real-Time docs state per-session capacity: audiences beyond 25,000 viewers and up to 12 hosts on a stage. Beyond those headline numbers, the pack does not document what changes as a session grows (behavior, tiers, degradation, or limits beyond 25k). missing for 10: documentation of what changes as a session grows, detailed quotas or limits pages, independent corroboration of the participant and viewer limits.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how many participants or viewers one session supports and what changes as a session grows

citations.quote: Accommodate audiences beyond 25,000 viewers and enable up to 12 hosts to take the virtual stage.
